# sylve_jail_snapshot_rollback (Resource)

Rolls a sylve_jail back to a prior sylve_jail_snapshot. One-shot ACTION, not persistent state -- see sylve_vm_snapshot_rollback's own description for the full reasoning (shared: `trigger` re-fires on change, `Delete` is a deliberate no-op, Sylve hardcodes destroying newer state as part of the rollback with no partial option).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# One-shot ACTION -- see sylve_vm_snapshot_rollback's own example for
# the shared reasoning (trigger + RequiresReplace to re-fire,
# deliberately no-op Delete).
resource "sylve_jail_snapshot_rollback" "restore" {
  ctid        = sylve_jail.example.ctid
  snapshot_id = tonumber(sylve_jail_snapshot.before_upgrade.id)
  trigger     = "restore-1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ctid` (Number) CTID of the sylve_jail to roll back.
- `snapshot_id` (Number) ID of the sylve_jail_snapshot to roll back to.
- `trigger` (String) Arbitrary string. Changing it re-fires the rollback -- see the resource's own description.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Terraform resource identity. Not a real external ID -- just "<ctid>-<snapshot_id>" for display.
